Career Profile

Hello! I’m Eun Jung, a Master’s student in the Electrical and Computer Engineering department at Sungkyunkwan University, advised by Professor Hyoungshick Kim. I am interested in AI security.

Research Interest

My research focuses on the security of AI systems, with particular attention to vulnerabilities in deep learning models and large language models (LLMs). I am interested in adversarial attacks, aiming to improve the robustness and reliability of AI systems in real-world applications.
